title_en: Enoch translated to heaven without dying
description_en: Enoch walked with God, and he was no more, for God took him. No death recorded — he was taken up directly.
research_notes: Parallell: Elia (2 Kung 2:11). Hebreerbrevet 11:5 bekräftar. Von Däniken citerar ofta.

title_en: Three visitors appear to Abraham at Mamre
description_en: Three men appear to Abraham, two later identified as angels. They eat, announce Isaac's birth, and proceed toward Sodom. Abraham addresses one as 'Lord' (YHWH).
research_notes: Teofani eller ängelmöte? En av de tre verkar vara YHWH själv. Fysisk interaktion (måltid). Morfologi: mänsklig.

title_en: Sodom and Gomorrah destroyed from above
description_en: YHWH rained sulfur and fire from heaven on Sodom and Gomorrah. The cities and all vegetation destroyed. Lot's wife turned to a pillar of salt.
research_notes: Föregås av änglarnas besök (BIB_OT_GEN_002). Von Däniken: kärnvapensprängning. Elden kom uppifrån. Blindning av Sodomiternas angripare (Gen 19:11).

title_en: Hagar encounters the Angel of the LORD in the wilderness
description_en: The Angel of the LORD finds Hagar by a spring and speaks with her. She names the place 'El-Roi' (the God who sees). First named angel encounter in the Bible.

title_en: Angel stops Abraham from sacrificing Isaac; provides ram
description_en: The Angel of the LORD calls from heaven and stops Abraham mid-action. Voice from heaven. No physical form described.

title_en: Jacob's ladder — angels ascending and descending
description_en: Jacob dreams of a ladder (or staircase) reaching heaven with angels ascending and descending. YHWH stands at the top. Jacob says 'this is the gate of heaven'.
research_notes: Hebreiska 'sullam' = ladder/ramp. Används i forntidsteknologisk litteratur som portal eller landningsramp.

title_en: Jacob wrestles with a 'man' all night
description_en: Jacob wrestles with an unnamed 'man' (ish) until dawn. The being cannot overpower Jacob but dislocates his hip with a touch. Blesses him and gives him the name Israel. Jacob says 'I have seen God face to face'.
research_notes: Fysisk kontakt, varaktig kroppsskada. Entitetens identitet debatteras: ängel (Hos 12:4) eller teofani. Jämför CE3-fall med fysisk påverkan.

title_en: Moses encounters burning bush — Angel of the LORD in flame
description_en: The Angel of the LORD appears in a flame of fire from within a bush. The bush burns but is not consumed. Voice identifies itself as 'I AM'. Moses hides his face.
research_notes: Ljusfenomen kombinerat med röst/kommunikation. Anomalt bränningsbeteende.

title_en: Pillar of cloud by day, pillar of fire by night
description_en: YHWH goes before the Israelites in a pillar of cloud to guide them by day and a pillar of fire to give light by night. The same cloud covers and lifts from the tabernacle.
research_notes: Navigeringsfunktion. Rör sig. Skyddar Israeliterna mot egyptierna (14:19-20). Persistent fenomen under 40 år.

title_en: Sinai theophany — fire, smoke, earthquake, trumpet
description_en: Mount Sinai covered in smoke because YHWH descended in fire. The whole mountain shook violently. Sound of a trumpet grew louder. The LORD descended to the top of the mountain.
research_notes: Ljusfenomen (eld), rök, seismisk aktivitet, ljud. Folket förbjuds att komma nära. Von Däniken: landning.

title_en: Moses sees the glory of the LORD — back only
description_en: YHWH passes before Moses and Moses is allowed to see only his 'back'. Moses' face shone so brightly he had to wear a veil. The LORD 'passed by' and proclaimed his name.
research_notes: Radiation-liknande effekt på Moses' ansikte. Jämför 2 Kor 3:7.

title_en: Moses and the elders of Israel see God and eat
description_en: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders went up and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like pavement of sapphire, clear as the sky. They ate and drank.
research_notes: 74 vittnen. Sapphirliknande yta (jfr Hes 1:26). Fysisk interaktion.

title_en: Balaam's donkey sees the Angel of the LORD; donkey speaks
description_en: An angel with a drawn sword stands in Balaam's path, invisible to Balaam but visible to the donkey. The donkey refuses to pass, is beaten, and finally speaks to Balaam. Angel then becomes visible.
research_notes: Djur reagerar på entitet som vittnet inte kan se. Parallell till UAP-fall med djurreaktion.

title_en: Joshua meets commander of the LORD's army with drawn sword
description_en: A man appears before Joshua near Jericho with a drawn sword. Identifies himself as commander of the LORD's army. Joshua falls face down. The ground is holy.

title_en: Angel of the LORD commissions Gideon; fire from rock
description_en: Angel sits under an oak and commissions Gideon. Gideon prepares food offering; the angel touches it with his staff and fire flares from the rock, consuming the offering. Angel vanishes.
research_notes: Plötslig försvinnande. Energiutsläpp (eld). Kommunikation och uppdrag.

title_en: Angel announces Samson's birth; ascends in altar flame
description_en: Angel of the LORD appears to Manoah's wife and announces a son. Appears again to both. When they offer a sacrifice, the flame goes up and the angel ascends in the flame. They fall prostrate.
research_notes: Uppstigning i eld/rök. Jmf Elia (2 Kung 2:11). Morfologi: mänsklig ('man of God'), ej vingad omnämnd.

title_en: Elijah fed by an angel twice; then travels 40 days
description_en: Elijah lies down exhausted under a juniper tree. An angel touches him and says 'Get up and eat'. Bread baked over coals and a jar of water appear. This happens twice. Elijah then travels 40 days on the strength of that food.

title_en: Elijah hears a still small voice after wind, earthquake and fire
description_en: On Mount Horeb: a great and powerful wind tears mountains, an earthquake, then fire. YHWH not in any of these. After the fire: a still small voice (or sound of gentle blowing). YHWH speaks to Elijah.

title_en: Elijah taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire and whirlwind
description_en: Chariots of fire and horses of fire appear and separate Elijah and Elisha. Elijah goes up into heaven in a whirlwind. Elisha watches and cries 'The chariots and horsemen of Israel!'
research_notes: Upptagning i ett farkostliknande fenomen. Brandbeskrivning. Fyra vittnen (Elisha + 50 profeter som sökte Elia). Von Däniken klassiker.

title_en: Elisha's servant sees the mountain full of fiery chariots
description_en: Elisha prays that his servant's eyes be opened. The servant sees the hills full of horses and chariots of fire surrounding them.
research_notes: Synfält öppnat avsiktligt. Stor flotta av lysande farkoster. Vittneskrets utökad via bön.

title_en: 185,000 Assyrian soldiers killed overnight by an angel
description_en: The Angel of the LORD goes out and kills 185,000 in the Assyrian camp. When the survivors wake up in the morning, all the corpses are there.
research_notes: Massiv destruktiv kapacitet. Ingen synlig manifestation beskriven — nattlig handling.

title_en: Isaiah sees the LORD enthroned, attended by six-winged seraphim
description_en: Isaiah sees the LORD sitting on a high and lofty throne. Seraphim with six wings each fly above him. They call 'Holy, holy, holy'. The temple fills with smoke. A seraph flies to Isaiah with a live coal from the altar.
research_notes: Serafer = sex-vingade varelser. Rök/dimmafyllt rum. Fysisk kontakt (glödande kol mot läpparna). Entitetstaxonomi: Seraphim.

title_en: Ezekiel's chariot vision — the living creatures and the wheels
description_en: A stormy wind comes from the north with a vast cloud and flashing fire. Four living creatures emerge, each with four faces and four wings. Beside each creature is a wheel-within-a-wheel, full of eyes, that can move in any direction without turning. Above them is a crystal expanse, then a sapphire throne with a figure like a man surrounded by radiance.
research_notes: Mest citerade 'UFO-passage' i bibeln. Josef Blumrich (NASA-ingenjör) rekonstruerade fordonet 1974. Norrlig ankomstriktning. Rör sig som ett rymdskepp. Hjul med ögon = sensorer? Cherubim är entitetstyperna.

title_en: Ezekiel lifted up between earth and heaven by the Spirit
description_en: A figure that looked like a man stretches out what appears to be a hand and grasps Ezekiel by the hair. The Spirit lifts Ezekiel up between earth and heaven and in visions of God brings him to Jerusalem.
research_notes: Levitation/teleportation. Fysisk kontakt (tas tag i håret). Transport från Babylon till Jerusalem. Jämför CE4-abduktionsfall.

title_en: The glory of the LORD departs the Temple on the chariot
description_en: The glory of the LORD, with the cherubim and wheels (the chariot), rises from the threshold of the temple, moves to the east gate, then to the mountain east of the city. Ezekiel watches it leave.
research_notes: Avfärd beskriven steg för steg. Rutt: tempeltröskel → östport → Oljeberget. Preciserade rörelsemönster.

title_en: Daniel sees a figure of a man — clothed in linen, face like lightning
description_en: A man clothed in linen, with a belt of gold, body like topaz, face like lightning, eyes like torches of fire, arms and legs like burnished bronze, voice like the sound of a multitude. Only Daniel sees it; others flee trembling.
research_notes: Morfologibeskrivning i detalj. Vittnena runt Daniel reagerar utan att se — känsla av närvaro. Parallelltill Uppenbarelsebokens entiteter.

title_en: Daniel sees the Ancient of Days and the Son of Man coming on clouds
description_en: The Ancient of Days sits on a flaming throne with wheels of blazing fire. A river of fire flows from his presence. Ten thousand times ten thousand stand before him. Then one like a Son of Man comes on the clouds of heaven.
research_notes: Tronen har hjul (ofanim). Molnbaserad transport ('kom på himmelens skyar'). Jmf Hes 1.

title_en: Fourth figure seen in the fiery furnace — like a son of gods
description_en: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego thrown into furnace so hot it kills the soldiers throwing them. The king sees four men walking unharmed in the fire. The fourth looks like 'a son of the gods' or 'an angel'.
research_notes: Entitet skyddar mot extrem värme. Morfologi: mänsklig men annorlunda.

title_en: Zechariah's vision of a man on a red horse among myrtle trees
description_en: Zechariah sees a man riding a red horse standing among myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him are red, brown, and white horses. An angel interprets the vision. The riders report having patrolled the earth.
research_notes: Patrullerande enheter som rapporterar tillbaka. Tolkande ängel närvarande.

title_en: Zechariah's vision of a flying scroll
description_en: A flying scroll, 20 cubits long and 10 cubits wide (approx. 9x4.5m), flies over the land. It is a curse going out over all the land.
research_notes: Flygande rektangulärt objekt med angivna dimensioner. Rör sig i luften. Von Däniken-källa.

title_en: Zechariah's vision of a woman in a basket carried by two winged women
description_en: A woman (representing wickedness) is put in a measuring basket. Two women with wings like storks carry the basket up between heaven and earth, toward the land of Shinar.
research_notes: Transport av person i ett behållar-liknande objekt av bevingade entiteter. Destination: Babylon.

title_en: Star of Bethlehem guides the Magi
description_en: A star appears in the east and guides the Magi to Jerusalem and then to Bethlehem, stopping over the house where the child was.
research_notes: Navigerar Magi (ändrar kurs via varning i dröm). Stannar/hovrar över ett specifikt hus. Rör sig oberoende av stjärnornas normala rörelse.

title_en: Jesus's baptism — dove, voice from heaven
description_en: At Jesus's baptism, the heavens open, the Spirit of God descends like a dove, and a voice from heaven says 'This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased'.
research_notes: Öppning i himlavalvet beskriven. Rörlig entitet (duvlik). Publik röst. Parallellberättelser: Mark 1:10, Luk 3:22, Joh 1:32.

title_en: Transfiguration — Jesus's face shines, Moses and Elijah appear, voice from cloud
description_en: Jesus's face shines like the sun and clothes become white as light. Moses and Elijah appear and talk with him. A bright cloud envelops them and a voice from the cloud says 'This is my beloved Son'. Disciples fall prostrate.
research_notes: Luminescens. Molnobjekt med röst. Materialisering av döda personer. Fysisk reaktion hos vittnen (föll mot marken). Parallell: Mark 9:2, Luk 9:28.

title_en: Angel rolls away the stone — appearance like lightning
description_en: An angel of the Lord descends from heaven, rolls back the stone, and sits on it. His appearance is like lightning and his clothes white as snow. The guards shake and become like dead men.
research_notes: Luminescens. Paralyserande effekt på vittnen. Nedstigning från himlen.

title_en: Gabriel appears to Zechariah in the temple
description_en: The angel Gabriel appears at the right side of the altar of incense. Zechariah is startled and gripped by fear. Gabriel announces the birth of John the Baptist. Zechariah is struck mute for doubting.
research_notes: Namngiven entitet (Gabriel). Plötsligt uppträdande inomhus. Fysisk bieffekt (stumhet) vid tvivel.

title_en: Gabriel appears to Mary — the Annunciation
description_en: The angel Gabriel is sent from God to a virgin named Mary. He announces she will conceive and bear a son by the Holy Spirit. The Most High's power will overshadow her.
research_notes: Namngiven entitet. Fysisk biologisk effekt (konception). Jmf jungfrufödelse-mönstret i forntidsteknologisk litteratur.

title_en: Angelic host appears to shepherds — glory of the Lord shines
description_en: The glory of the Lord shines around the shepherds and they are terrified. An angel appears with the news of Jesus's birth. Then a great company of the heavenly host appears with the angel, praising God. They suddenly disappear.
research_notes: Massuppvisning. Lysande fenomen (glory). Plötslig försvinnande ('went back into heaven'). Flertal vittnen.

title_en: Jesus ascends into heaven — cloud takes him from sight
description_en: Jesus is taken up into the air and a cloud takes him out of the disciples' sight. Two men in white suddenly stand beside them and say he will return in the same way he left.
research_notes: Molnobjekt som upptar person. Två entiteter materialiserar. Löfte om återkomst 'på samma sätt'. Publik händelse med 11 vittnen.

title_en: Voice from heaven at Jesus's triumphal entry — thunder or angel?
description_en: Jesus asks the Father to glorify his name. A voice from heaven says 'I have glorified it and will glorify it again.' The crowd says it thundered; others say an angel spoke to him.
research_notes: Vittnen tolkar samma fenomen olika (åska vs. röst). Ambiguitet i perception — parallell till UAP-vittnesberättelser.

title_en: Pentecost — rushing wind and tongues of fire
description_en: A sudden sound like a violent rushing wind fills the whole house. What seems to be tongues of fire separate and come to rest on each of them. They begin to speak in other languages.
research_notes: Ljusfenomen (eldtungor). Ljudfenomen (sus). Kognitiv effekt (talförmåga). 120 vittnen.

title_en: Peter freed from prison by an angel of the Lord
description_en: A light shines in the cell. The angel strikes Peter on the side, wakes him, and chains fall from Peter's wrists. The angel leads him out through the city; the iron gate opens by itself. The angel suddenly disappears.
research_notes: Ljus i mörkret. Låsupptagning utan nyckel. Plötslig försvinnande.

title_en: Paul's conversion — blinding light from heaven, voice
description_en: A light from heaven flashes around Paul (and his companions) on the road to Damascus. Paul falls to the ground. A voice says 'Saul, why do you persecute me?' Paul is blinded for three days. His companions hear the sound but see no one (or see the light but hear no voice — accounts differ).
research_notes: Ljus starkare än middag (Apg 26:13). Fallbeteende. Blindning (CE2-liknande fysiologisk effekt). Vittnen med delade upplevelser (höra/se olika). Tre motstridiga redogörelser i Apostlagärningarna.

title_en: Philip teleported from Gaza road to Azotus
description_en: After baptizing the Ethiopian eunuch, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly takes Philip away. The eunuch sees him no more. Philip appears at Azotus, some 40 km away.
research_notes: Plötslig teleportation ~40 km. Ögonvittne (eunucken). Jmf Hes 8:3 (Hesekiel lyfts). Modern UAP-parallell: missing time / spatial dislokation.

title_en: John's vision on Patmos — the Son of Man among lampstands
description_en: John hears a loud voice like a trumpet. He turns and sees one like a Son of Man, with white hair like wool or snow, eyes like blazing fire, feet like bronze glowing in a furnace, voice like the sound of rushing waters. He holds seven stars; a sharp two-edged sword comes from his mouth. His face is like the sun shining at full strength. John falls at his feet as though dead.
research_notes: Detaljerad morfologibeskrivning. Luminescens. Paralyserande effekt. Jmf Dan 10:5-9 (nästintill identisk beskrivning).

title_en: John taken through an open door into heaven
description_en: John sees a door standing open in heaven. A voice like a trumpet says 'Come up here and I will show you what must take place.' At once John is in the Spirit and sees the throne room.
research_notes: Portal/öppning i himlavalvet. Röst med navigeringsuppdrag. Transport 'in the Spirit'. Jmf Hes 8:3; 2 Kor 12:2 (Paulus tredje himlen).

title_en: Four living creatures around the throne — full of eyes, six wings
description_en: Four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind. First like a lion, second like an ox, third with a human face, fourth like an eagle. Each has six wings and is covered with eyes. They never stop saying 'Holy, holy, holy'.
research_notes: Morfologi: fyra olika djurliknande ansikten. Sexvingade. Fulla av ögon (sensorer?). Direkt parallell till Hes 1 (cherubim). Transmorf-taxonomi: Cherubim.

title_en: A mighty angel comes down from heaven wrapped in a cloud
description_en: A mighty angel comes down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head, face like the sun, and legs like pillars of fire. He plants one foot on the sea and one on the land. He shouts like the roar of a lion and seven thunders speak.
research_notes: Molnomslutet objekt. Luminescens (ansikte som solen). Eldpelare (ben). Enorm skala. Sju åskor som kommunicerar.

title_en: The woman clothed with the sun — dragon in heaven
description_en: A great sign in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars. A great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns appears. The dragon is thrown to earth. The woman flies to the desert on eagle's wings.
research_notes: Symbolisk/allegorisk. Rymdbatalj-scenario. Transport på 'örnavingar' = teknisk liknelse?

title_en: Paul caught up to the third heaven — paradise
description_en: Paul describes being caught up to the third heaven 14 years earlier. He does not know whether in the body or out of the body. He heard inexpressible things. He was given a thorn in the flesh afterward.
research_notes: Osäkerhet om kroppen var med (OBE?). Episodisk amnesi ('vet inte'). Efterföljande kroppslig effekt. Jmf modern abduktionsforskning.

title_en: Stephen's vision of the Son of Man standing at right hand of God
description_en: Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looks up to heaven and sees the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God. He describes this aloud. The crowd rushes at him.
research_notes: Ensidigt synfält (bara Stephen ser). Öppning i himlen observeras. Triggers dödsupplevelse.

title_en: Legion possesses man; demons transferred to swine herd that drowns
description_en: A man with an unclean spirit, of superhuman strength, lives among tombs. 'Legion' (many demons) possess him. Jesus casts them out; they enter 2,000 pigs which rush into the sea and drown.
research_notes: Multipla entiteter i ett värd. Massivt beteendefenomen hos djur. 'Legion' = latinskt militärt begrepp (6 000 soldater).
